protocol: Paired retrospective comparison at the same budget and paid price per game. Portfolios see only previous days. The live Fixed Share policy uses up to 104 prior dates with complete outcomes. The random scorer is a single reproducible comparator. These diagnostics are exploratory and cannot establish predictive advantage.

paired_inference.date_unit: All draws on the same date form one paired block.
paired_inference.p_raw: Two-sided exact sign-flip under symmetric paired date-level differences.
paired_inference.p_holm: Holm family-wide adjustment over applicable game/method/threshold comparisons.
paired_inference.ci: Percentile date-cluster bootstrap for candidate minus comparator hit rates in percentage points.
paired_inference.rare: Fewer than 5 dates with different hit totals. Degenerate empirical intervals are possible.

protocol.frozen_rebench: Live LR walk-forward selects from training dates once, then reranks on each prior-day prefix.
protocol.dynamic_catalog: The normal live LR budget generator runs once per date on the complete earlier prefix. Its bounded rolling comparison scores paid variants before the forecast date.
protocol.new: The two numeric scorers rank the main urn, using the independent frequency Joker pool. The live Fixed Share portfolio policy is replayed from the complete earlier prefix.
protocol.paired: Exact paid tickets at the same price per game. A date with two official draws uses one forecast for both outcomes. A day is counted once in method/fallback summaries.
